name: Titan Clans
worldbuilding: Ogre kingdoms, giant tribes, monstrous nomads, and beast clans. Their ordinary warriors are already exceptionally large and powerful, while their armies rely on physical mass and devastating Charges.

factionCommands.name: Thunderous Advance
factionCommands.effect: One friendly Unit makes an additional Move before declaring a Charge.

factionCommands.name: Smash Through
factionCommands.effect: One friendly Unit's next Charge Impact this Phase ignores one step of temporary Armor improvement on the target (use its normal printed Armor for this Impact if a bonus improved it). Impact already ignores Evade and Cover.

factionCommands.name: Roar of Dominance
factionCommands.effect: Choose one friendly Monster. Enemies cannot use Reactions against that Monster until the end of the Phase.

abilities.name: Massive Charge
abilities.effect: Roll 3d6 for this unit's charges and keep the two highest.

abilities.name: Stampede
abilities.effect: Gain Impact +2 on a successful Charge.

abilities.name: Covering Barrage
abilities.effect: While this Unit remains stationary, friendly Monster Units within Medium gain Accurate 1 on their next Charge-phase Attack.

abilities.name: Stampede
abilities.effect: Gain Impact +2 on a successful Charge.

abilities.name: Throw Aside
abilities.effect: After inflicting an unsaved Hit to an engaged unit or after a successful Charge, reposition one enemy basic Model up to 2" to a legal position, maintaining Unit coherency.

abilities.name: Earthshatter
abilities.effect: On 3+, inflict Direct Damage 1 and Slow 1 on one visible enemy within Short.

abilities.name: Crack the Whip
abilities.effect: When a friendly Monster or Beast Unit within Short rolls its Charge Pool, reroll up to two dice, respecting the usual reroll restriction.

abilities.name: Huge
abilities.effect: Counts as three Units for objective control.

abilities.name: Mobile Fortress
abilities.effect: Friendly units immediately behind the Mammoth benefit from Cover where appropriate.

factionLeader.name: Overtyrant

abilities.name: Supreme Bully
abilities.effect: The Overtyrant's Engagement Attacks gain Anti-Monster 2 and Anti-Character 2.

abilities.name: The Crushing Tide
abilities.effect: Up to two friendly Ogre or Monster Units within Medium gain +1 Impact and +1 Damage on their next Engagement Attack this Round.

knownIssues: No printed Impact value, unusual for a melee-focused faction's Leader (every other Titan Clans signature melee Unit prints an Impact bonus or Massive Charge). Likely a drafting gap rather than intentional, since the Overtyrant otherwise has the faction's heaviest melee kit; not resolved here.

genericUnitsWorthTaking: Cheap auxiliaries, conventional Ranged Infantry, light mobile troops, Scouts, and ordinary Support Units. Ogre Warriors and Beast Riders are devastating but too expensive to efficiently cover every objective.
designNotes: v4.2 balance pass: added Stone Hurlers as the faction's Extra Core, a stationary ranged-support Monster unit reinforcing the Heavy Support doctrine rather than patching a weakness. Damage-1 weapons across the faction gained +1 Attack; Damage-2+ weapons kept their Attacks and gained a thematic Anti-[Type] (Anti-Armored on Ogre Warriors' Heavy Clubs and the Giant's Massive Club, Anti-Infantry on Beast Riders' Mauling Harness, Anti-Elite on the Tyrant's Great Weapon) or an improved Hit (War Mammoth's Crushing Tusks 4+ -> 3+). The Overtyrant's Supreme Bully passive also had its Anti-Monster/Anti-Character values doubled from 1 to 2.
